title: We Are Born Good (bc30)
synopsis: A botched takeaway order sparks an unlikely battle of wills in We Are Born Good, the assured debut of Hong Kong filmmaker Yeung Leung Chuen. Aspiring actress Zoey is already at breaking point, weighed down by debt, disappointment and a city that seems determined to test her patience. When a neighbourhood restaurant refuses to remake her incorrect order at closing time, a petty grievance quickly escalates. As their confrontation spirals into chaos, hostility slowly gives way to an unexpected connection. Inspired by viral footage of trivia disputes erupting into violence, the film asks what drives ordinary people to the brink–and whether kindness can still prevail.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 你有多少次因為一件簡單的生活小事，氣上心頭，纏繞你一整天？坐你對面的成隻鞋踩上凳，後面排隊的貼到你實一實，巴士等極都飛站，忍忍忍了一整天終於可以食餐好，外賣員送錯餐，再大量的你都會秒變「醬爆」，自此一發不可收拾！電影靈感源自網絡瘋傳閉路電視片段，看似無關痛癢的生活小事，卻觸發起無窮無盡的怨氣，荒謬得寫實，寫實得荒謬，道盡小市民的「辛活日常」。當人人「忍一時激親自己，退一步益埋人哋」的時候，選擇善良，在現世還有立足之地嗎？

cast: Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, Kearen Pang, Lo Chun Yip, Ng Wing Sze, Amy Yan Yuk Yu
